name: Google Docs (read-write, service account)
description: Google Docs, read and edit (scope documents): documents.create, get (with tabs, suggestions and comments view modes), batchUpdate (text, styles, tables, images, tabs, headers and footers, comments, suggestions, …). No Drive endpoints, so it cannot share, move, export, or delete files. Auth: drawlatch signs a JWT with GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY (base64 of the service-account JSON key file) and mints short-lived access tokens for exactly this scope; the agent never sees the key. Without a subject it edits documents shared with the service account as Editor (sharing as Viewer or Commenter does not let it change their content) and link-shared ones whose link grants edit, and cannot create documents (service accounts own no files); with one (domain-wide delegation) every document that user can open, and it can create documents owned by that user. See CONNECTIONS.md "Google (scoped)".

testConnection.description: Reads the ID of the public sample document from Google's Docs API quickstart (needs the Docs API enabled)
